simple.summary: וָהֵב (Vâhêb) means Vaheb , a place in Moab First listed occurrence: Num 21 14.

definitions.full: H2052. Vaheb וָהֵב , apparently proper name, of a location , בְּסוּפָה אֶתוָֿהֵב Num 21:14 , object of a verb now lost out of the text (compare RV & especially Di VB), situation unknown; ᵐ5 Ζωοβ , Ζοοβ ; so Lag BN 54 Say Academy (London). Oct. 22, 1892 ( זָהָב ).
